legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Logivya collects, uses, stores, shares, and protects personal data when you use the Logivya website, Android or iOS application, support services, connected communication channels such as WhatsApp, Telegram, and Facebook Pages, and freight marketplace features.
legal.privacy.controllerTitle: Who is responsible for your data
legal.privacy.controllerBody: Logivya is the data controller for account registration, authentication, security, billing, product administration, support, and freight marketplace data. When a user connects an authorized WhatsApp, Telegram, or Facebook Pages account and processes contacts, groups, pages, or message operations for their own use, that user determines the purpose of the processing and Logivya processes the data on the user's instructions.
legal.privacy.dataBody: Depending on the features you use, we process account and contact details such as name, email address, phone number, locale and timezone; workspace, team, role and invitation information; subscription, transaction, billing reference and invoice information; device, session, security and authentication records; support requests and attachments; notification tokens; photos, videos, files and documents you select; freight listing, demand, route, date, vehicle, driver, qualification and contact information; and limited usage or diagnostic events when the relevant preference is enabled.
legal.privacy.customerDataBody: When you connect a WhatsApp, Telegram, or Facebook Pages account you are authorized to use, Logivya may process encrypted session or access material, account and page identifiers, synchronized contact, group, chat, and page names, phone or messaging identifiers, categories, message and post destinations, text content, selected photos, videos, files and documents, schedules, delivery or publication status, history, and deletion outcomes. When you explicitly start smart matching, eligible messages from the connected sources you select may be analyzed to find freight opportunities. This data is isolated by workspace and account and is used only to provide the requested service, maintain security, and meet applicable legal obligations.
legal.privacy.purposesBody: We use personal data to create and secure accounts, authenticate users, provide connected-account messaging and page-publishing features, synchronize authorized contacts, groups, chats, and pages, deliver text and media, publish, search, and match freight listings and requests, manage teams and subscriptions, provide support and notifications, prevent abuse, maintain audit and recovery records, comply with law, and improve reliability. Optional analytics and diagnostics are used only in line with the applicable user preference.
legal.privacy.sourcesBody: Data comes from you, your workspace administrator, the device or browser you use, authorized WhatsApp, Telegram, and Facebook Pages connections, user-generated freight marketplace content, support communications, and service providers that confirm delivery, security, billing, or infrastructure events.
legal.privacy.sharingBody: We transfer only the data needed by providers that support hosting, databases, encrypted backups and file storage, email, push notifications, monitoring, diagnostics, and authorized connected-account features. When you explicitly send a message, media attachment, or page post, the selected content is transferred to the relevant WhatsApp, Telegram, or Facebook service to complete that action. Providers act under contractual and security obligations. We may also disclose information when required by law, to protect users or the service, or in connection with a lawful service transfer. We do not sell personal data.
legal.privacy.transfersBody: Some infrastructure and service providers may process data outside your country. Where required, Logivya uses appropriate contractual, administrative, and technical safeguards for international transfers and limits transferred data to what is necessary for the service.
legal.privacy.retentionBody: We retain data only for as long as needed for the service, account lifecycle, security, support, contractual, tax, dispute, fraud-prevention, backup, and legal-hold obligations. Operational queue data is removed on short automated schedules. Export files expire automatically. Approved account deletion removes or anonymizes eligible data, while narrowly restricted records may be retained when law or a legal hold requires it.
legal.privacy.securityBody: Logivya applies workspace and account isolation, encryption in transit and for sensitive stored material, role-based access controls, protected backups, audit records, secret redaction, and monitoring. No system is completely risk free, but we investigate security incidents and take reasonable steps to contain and correct them.
legal.privacy.choicesBody: You can update profile information, manage notification and optional analytics preferences, disconnect authorized accounts, request a data export, and start account deletion through the available application controls. Workspace administrators control team membership and workspace data according to their permissions.
legal.privacy.rightsBody: Subject to applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, or objection, and may withdraw consent where consent is the legal basis. You may also complain to the competent data protection authority. We verify identity and authority before fulfilling a request and will explain any lawful limitation.
legal.privacy.childrenBody: Logivya is a service for adult users and is not directed to children. Users must have the legal capacity required to use the service and connect an account.
legal.privacy.changesBody: We may update this policy when the service, providers, legal requirements, or data practices change. The effective date is shown at the top of this page. Material changes will be communicated through the service or another appropriate channel.
legal.privacy.contactBody: For privacy questions or to exercise your rights, email support@logivya.com. Do not send passwords, verification codes, access tokens, WhatsApp credentials, or other secrets.
publicSupport.title: Customer support
publicSupport.intro: Get help with your Logivya account, connected account, messaging, subscription, privacy, or security questions.
publicSupport.emailBody: Email us from the address registered to your Logivya account and include a concise description of the issue. Add a ticket reference when you already have one.
publicSupport.inAppBody: Signed-in users can open the Support area to create a request, read the conversation, and follow its status.
publicSupport.responseBody: Requests are reviewed in priority order. Security, account-access, and service-availability incidents are prioritized. Response time can vary with complexity and required verification.
publicSupport.safetyBody: Never send your password, authentication code, recovery code, access token, connected-account credential, or payment card data in a support request.
billing.ios.managedDescription: Your current plan is shown above. For subscription changes or billing questions, contact your workspace administrator or Logivya Support.
legal.deletion.title: Logivya account deletion
legal.deletion.intro: You can request deletion of your Logivya account and the personal data associated with it from the app or from this web page.
legal.deletion.inAppBody: Sign in, then open Settings, Privacy and data, and Delete account. The protected flow verifies your current password and requires an exact confirmation phrase.
legal.deletion.inAppAction: Sign in to the deletion flow
legal.deletion.webBody: Email support@logivya.com from the address registered to your account. Include your full name and state that you request account deletion. Never send your password, verification code, WhatsApp credential, or another secret.
legal.deletion.scopeBody: An approved user-account request removes or anonymizes the account and associated profile, sessions, device tokens and user-owned application data. Workspace deletion is owner-only and may require ownership transfer or member handling.
legal.deletion.retentionBody: Logivya may retain only records required for legal, accounting, security, fraud-prevention, dispute or legal-hold obligations. Retained records are restricted and are not used to continue the deleted account.
legal.deletion.impactBody: Support confirms subscription and workspace-owner consequences before execution. Approved execution revokes application sessions and removes the affected WhatsApp session credentials according to the verified deletion scope.
legal.deletion.timelineBody: The request is recorded when received. Identity, ownership, subscription and legal-hold checks are completed before execution. In-app queued requests include a seven-day cancellation period; support confirms the expected completion date for each verified request.
legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
legal.terms.usage: Logivya may be used only for lawful messaging operations that respect recipient consent.
legal.terms.marketplace: Users who publish load, vehicle, or driver listings are responsible for ensuring that listing information is accurate, current, lawful, and based on the required authority. Listings may not contain misleading, fraudulent, discriminatory, dangerous, or rights-infringing content.
legal.terms.prohibited: Spam, harassment, threats, fraud, illegal goods or services, unauthorized disclosure of personal data, impersonation, unauthorized access, and activities that put platform security at risk are prohibited.
legal.terms.moderation: Logivya may moderate content through automated checks, user reports, and human review. Content that violates these rules may be removed or limited, and accounts may be temporarily or permanently restricted.
legal.terms.reporting: Users can use the Report and Block tools on listing details. Reports are sent to support and moderation; marketplace content from blocked owners is hidden from the user's search results. Contact the appropriate authorities when there is an immediate safety risk or suspected unlawful activity.
legal.terms.enforcement: You can appeal a moderation decision or provide more information by creating a request in the in-app Support section. Logivya may process records needed for review in accordance with applicable privacy and retention rules.
legal.kvkk.title: KVKK Privacy Notice
legal.kvkk.processing: Your personal data is processed under Turkish Law No. 6698 for service delivery, security, support, and legal obligations.
legal.kvkk.rights: Contact support@logivya.com to exercise your rights of access, rectification, deletion, and objection.

legal.cookies.body: Essential cookies are used for sessions and security. Analytics and marketing cookies are enabled only with user consent.

legal.dpa.body: For data processed on behalf of customers, Logivya fulfills its obligations as a processor regarding security, confidentiality, and access control.
